chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
He said: “What do women have to do with takhyīr (being given the choice in divorce)? That is only something which Allah specifically granted to His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.التَّخْيِيرَ: granting a choice, here referring to being given the choice in divorce
key_terms.النِّسَاءِ: women; the subject being discussed in relation to the ruling
key_terms.شَيْءٌ: a matter or ruling being referred to
key_terms.نَبِيَّهُ: His Prophet, meaning the Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: Was the ruling of takhyīr for wives a general law or something specific to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the legal matter of takhyīr in this sense is not a general ruling for women, but a special matter granted by Allah to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. It indicates a specific prophetic distinction in family law and limits the broader application of this form of choice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4815 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) that he said:

"What do women have to do with takhyīr (being given the choice in divorce)?
That is something which Allah specifically granted to His Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family)."
